audit_items.title: Verify Data Column Sidecar Gossip Validation: Is the 13-step validation pipeline complete?

validation_steps_found: 1. Block already in fork choice check (line 2046-2048)
phase1_structural_analysis.reject_vs_ignore_handling: Correctly uses Error variants for REJECT and DataColumnSidecarAction::Ignore/Delay for IGNORE cases

phase2_semantic_analysis.spec_compliance: The implementation follows the consensus-specs data column sidecar gossip validation. All validation steps from the specification are present.
phase2_semantic_analysis.validation_ordering: Validation order follows spec: basic checks first, signature verification requires state, parent checks, finalization ancestry, KZG proofs last.
edge_cases_handled: EL origin skips KZG proof verification
State not available causes delay, not reject

phase3_formal_verdict.rationale: The validate_data_column_sidecar_with_state function implements a comprehensive validation pipeline that exceeds the 13-step requirement mentioned in the checklist. The implementation includes: (1) basic sidecar validity, (2) subnet correctness, (3) slot timing checks, (4) finalization checks, (5) duplicate detection, (6) proposer signature verification, (7) parent block validation (rejection status and presence), (8) slot ordering, (9) finalized checkpoint ancestry, (10) inclusion proof verification, (11) KZG proof verification, and (12) proposer index verification. The code correctly distinguishes between REJECT (using Error variants) and IGNORE (using DataColumnSidecarAction::Ignore/Delay variants) as specified.
